title: HtmlInputSearch
responsibility: Renders the native input control with type search without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlInputSearch.children
inputs.description: Optional Svelte Snippet declared in the props type and removed from the spread by destructuring, so it is never forwarded to the element. The markup never renders it, so passing a snippet has no effect on the output.

outputs.name: HtmlInputSearch
outputs.description: The native input element itself: every prop except children is spread onto it, then type is set to 'search', so a caller-supplied type never takes effect. No wrapper element is rendered, and the markup body is whitespace only, so no child content is written.
